sections.title: RAG Applications for Boston Organizations
sections.description: Production RAG solutions for Boston's leading organizations.

blocks.heading: Biotech Scientific Literature RAG
paragraphs: For Biogen (Cambridge HQ), Moderna (Cambridge HQ), Vertex Pharmaceuticals (Boston HQ), and the Cambridge biotech cluster:

Drug discovery literature intelligence: RAG over PubMed, bioRxiv preprints, and proprietary research databases — Biogen's scientists can ask natural language questions like 'What structural modifications have improved selectivity for this target in the published literature?' and receive synthesized answers from thousands of relevant papers, with precise citations for follow-up.

Clinical development research RAG: RAG over regulatory agency guidances (FDA, EMA, ICH), clinical trial precedent (ClinicalTrials.gov), and published clinical study results for Boston biotech's clinical development teams — enabling protocol designers to query the evidence base for endpoint selection, statistical approaches, and regulatory precedent.

Competitive intelligence RAG: RAG monitoring competitor pipeline publications, patent filings, and investor presentations for Boston biotech's business intelligence programs — synthesizing competitive landscape information from publicly available sources into natural language intelligence briefings.
All biotech RAG: self-hosted Llama 3 on corporate infrastructure — research IP never leaves the company network.
Cost: $40,000–$115,000 | Timeline: 10–20 weeks | Self-hosted, research IP protection

blocks.heading: Clinical Knowledge Management RAG
paragraphs: For Mass General Brigham, Dana-Farber, Boston Children's, and Beth Israel Deaconess:

Evidence-based medicine RAG: RAG over clinical practice guidelines (UpToDate, NCCN, ACC/AHA guidelines), hospital formularies, and clinical protocols for Boston's large clinical workforce — enabling physicians and nurses to query current evidence-based standards in natural language at the point of care, reducing time spent searching clinical databases during rounds.

Tumor board and oncology RAG: RAG over Dana-Farber's and Mass General's institutional oncology case histories, current tumor board references, and clinical trial portfolios — supporting the tumor board preparation process that Boston's world-class cancer programs conduct for complex oncology cases.

Pharmacy and formulary RAG: Drug information, formulary decision support, and clinical pharmacology knowledge RAG for Boston's large pharmacy departments — enabling pharmacists to query drug interactions, dosing guidelines, and formulary alternatives in natural language.
Cost: $40,000–$115,000 | Timeline: 10–20 weeks | HIPAA BAA

blocks.heading: Investment Research and Compliance RAG
paragraphs: For Fidelity Investments (Boston HQ) and State Street (Boston HQ):

Investment research corpus RAG: RAG over Fidelity's and third-party research reports, earnings transcripts, and SEC filings for Fidelity's research analysts — enabling investment professionals to query the firm's institutional research knowledge in natural language alongside structured financial data.

Asset management compliance RAG: RAG over SEC regulations, FINRA rules, Massachusetts securities law, and internal compliance policies for Boston's large investment management sector — enabling compliance officers to research regulatory requirements across the full compliance framework without manual document review.
ESG research intelligence: RAG over ESG disclosures, sustainability reports, and impact reporting for the rapidly growing ESG investment programs at Boston's major asset managers.
Cost: $40,000–$115,000 | Timeline: 10–20 weeks | SEC/FINRA recordkeeping

blocks.heading: Engineering Documentation RAG for Robotics
paragraphs: For Boston Dynamics (Waltham) and Boston's robotics cluster:

Robot platform documentation RAG: RAG over Boston Dynamics' extensive Spot, Stretch, and Atlas technical documentation — enabling engineers and customers to query platform specifications, SDK documentation, and integration guides in natural language.

Research literature RAG for robotics: RAG over IEEE Robotics and Automation Society publications, ICRA papers, and internal research memos for Boston Dynamics' research teams — enabling robotics researchers to query the published literature for relevant prior work.

blocks.heading: Scientific accuracy requirements
paragraphs: Boston's biotech and clinical RAG requires higher accuracy than most enterprise RAG — a hallucinated drug-drug interaction or a misattributed clinical outcome has professional consequences. ClickMasters implements hallucination detection guardrails, citation verification, and confidence scoring as standard for all Boston scientific RAG.

blocks.heading: Self-hosted for all biotech RAG
paragraphs: Boston's biotech research community operates with proprietary data that cannot leave corporate networks. ClickMasters deploys Llama 3 70B on corporate infrastructure for all Boston biotech RAG — no exceptions.

blocks.heading: HIPAA BAA for clinical RAG
paragraphs: All clinical knowledge RAG for Boston's health systems requires HIPAA BAA with the LLM provider — AWS Bedrock and Azure OpenAI both provide HIPAA BAAs. ClickMasters deploys clinical RAG on Bedrock or Azure as standard.
